hooks.prompt: Check if any Elixir source files (.ex) were modified in the current session. If significant changes were made (new modules added/removed, public functions changed, schemas altered, routes added/removed, status enums changed), verify that the nearest CLAUDE.md file in the module's directory accurately reflects those changes. If a CLAUDE.md is out of date, respond with {"decision": "block", "reason": "CLAUDE.md in [path] needs updating: [brief description of what changed]"} so the session can update it before finishing. If all CLAUDE.md files are current, respond with {"decision": "approve"}. Only flag truly significant changes — ignore formatting, comments, or minor refactors.
